description: This is a test class for NmapOutputProcessor, specifically testing the parsing of vulnerabilities in Nmap XML output. It extends a base parser test case, creates an instance of the processor, processes a resource file, and asserts the correctness of the parsed asset data.

classes.name: NmapOutputProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of NmapOutputProcessor's parsing logic.

methods.name: testParseVulnerabilities
methods.description: Tests the parsing of vulnerabilities from an Nmap XML output, verifying asset count, tags, children, and port values.
